displayName: Global Address Book Download Initial Delay
description: When set, this will delay the initial download of the Global Address Book by a random number between 0 and the number of minutes specified after sign-in.  When the value is 0, the download will begin immediately after sign-in.  By default, the value is 60.  This means that there will be a random delay between 0 and 60 minutes after sign-in before Lync begins to download the address book.
